acceptance: The local catalog links each project/worktree to its folder, scoped dashboard and live task data, with a separate local-workspace dashboard and launcher.
The local workspace shares the main task UI, switches projects/worktrees without mixing tasks, and protects native folder actions with registered roots and session/origin checks.
Trusted prompt/session hooks and owned instructions point agents to bounded global discovery, including projectless sessions; existing custom files and project-local ownership remain preserved.
The matching package is installed locally, the recorder and local dashboard run on this machine, and current configured checks and browser/package checks pass.
